name: Weather Card
description: A forecast card whose background is a small live scene of the weather, from clear sky to thunder.

props.name: condition
props.description: The weather in the scene. A change passes through the weather in between: cloud gathers before rain starts, rain stops before cloud breaks.

props.name: night
props.description: Darkens the scene, swaps the sun for a crescent moon and brings out stars on clear nights.

props.name: seed
props.description: Shapes the ridgelines, cloud bands and stars.

props.name: children
props.description: The forecast. It sits in a padded layer that switches to light text over dark skies, so text-foreground stays readable.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Set its width here; it is at least 17rem tall. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
